gap.title: A step toward: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 63 gates for the point-line incidence function of the projective plane of order 3 (step 2 of 2)
gap.statement: ∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 ∧     x1.size ≤ (63 : ℕ) ∧       let x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (↑x2 + ↑x3) % (13 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (1 : ℕ), (3 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)];       have x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x3 x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) (x5 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => if ↑x5 < (13 : ℕ) then Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x5 ∈ x3) else Decidable.decide (Fin.ofNat (13 : ℕ) ↑x5 ∈ x4);       have x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := fun (x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => {x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ) | ∀ x6 ∈ x4, ¬x2 x6 x5};       have x5 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Bool := fun (x5 x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x1.eval (List.ofFn (x3 x5 x6));       (∀ (x6 x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x2 x6 x7 → x5 {x6} {x7} = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x6.card ≤ (3 : ℕ) → x5 x6 (x4 x6) = Bool.false ∧ x5 (x4 x6) x6 = Bool.false
